description: Fixture-capture plan for tests/fixtures/sequence_*_{unrun,finished}.json. Not an observation plan: it lives under .opencode/ (pruned by _walk_visible) so audit_plans never sweeps it up, and its filters must exist in the active N.I.N.A. profile (Dark/L/LP here). L x5 + LP x3 at batch_size=2 exercises every projection branch in one snapshot: 5 structural 'Exposure Group' containers for lights, the Smart Exposure_Container name-shortcut for wheel darks, and a switchless bias (filter null). The 0.5 s single dark keeps the finished-run capture (A2) to seconds.
